articles.title_en: Nested replicator dynamics, nested logit choice, and similarity-based learning
articles.title_cn: 嵌套复制动态、嵌套Logit选择与基于相似性的学习
articles.abstract_en: We consider a model of learning and evolution in games whose action sets are endowed with a partition-based similarity structure intended to capture exogenous similarities between strategies. In this model, revising agents have a higher probability of comparing their current strategy with other strategies that they deem similar, and they switch to the observed strategy with probability proportional to its payoff excess. Because of this implicit bias toward similar strategies, the resulting dynamics – which we call the nested replicator dynamics – do not satisfy any of the standard monotonicity postulates for imitative game dynamics; nonetheless, we show that they retain the main long-run rationality properties of the replicator dynamics, albeit at quantitatively different rates. We also show that the induced dynamics can be viewed as a stimulus-response model in the spirit of Erev and Roth (1998), with choice probabilities given by the nested logit choice rule of Ben-Akiva (1973) and McFadden (1978). This result generalizes an existing relation between the replicator dynamics and the exponential weights algorithm in online learning, and provides an additional layer of interpretation to our analysis and results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个博弈中的学习与演化模型，其行动集具有基于划分的相似性结构，旨在捕捉策略之间的外生相似性。在该模型中，修订中的代理人更有可能将其当前策略与他们认为相似的其他策略进行比较，并且他们以与收益超额成比例的概率转向观察到的策略。由于这种对相似策略的隐性偏向，所产生的动态——我们称之为嵌套复制动态——不满足模仿博弈动态的任何标准单调性公设；尽管如此，我们表明它们保留了复制动态的主要长期理性性质，尽管在数量上以不同的速率。我们还表明，诱导动态可以被视为Erev和Roth (1998) 精神下的刺激-反应模型，其选择概率由Ben-Akiva (1973) 和McFadden (1978) 的嵌套Logit选择规则给出。这一结果推广了在线学习中复制动态与指数权重算法之间的现有关系，并为我们的分析和结果提供了额外的解释层面。

articles.title_en: Increasing returns and the efficient acquisition of information
articles.title_cn: 递增回报与信息的有效获取
articles.abstract_en: Increasing returns are inherent in information: the number of events that can be distinguished is an exponential function of the number of partitions applied to a state space. Just as factories should run at a large scale in the face of increasing returns, each partition should be coarse to allow the number of partitions to be large. This principle also holds for partitions, or equivalently questions, that are applied sequentially. When agents need to process all the answers to a question, 3-answer questions dominate the efficient arrays of questions. If however agents can deduce that when all but one of the answers to a question are rejected then the remaining answer must be accepted, binary questions are efficient. Counterintuitively, a decrease in the cost of processing answers reduces the efficient number of answers.
articles.abstract_cn: 递增回报是信息所固有的：可区分的事件数量是应用于状态空间的分割数量的指数函数。正如工厂在面临递增回报时应大规模运营一样，每个分割应保持粗糙，以便分割数量可以很大。这一原则也适用于顺序应用的分割，或等价地，问题。当代理人需要处理一个问题的所有答案时，3答案问题主导着有效的问题数组。然而，如果代理人能够推断出当一个问题的所有答案中除一个被拒绝时，剩余的答案必须被接受，那么二元问题是有效的。与直觉相反，处理答案成本的降低会减少有效的答案数量。

articles.title_en: Partially directed search in the labor market
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场中的部分定向搜索
articles.abstract_en: I study the labor market implications of an equilibrium search model with flexible degrees of information availability, which nests the random and directed search models as special cases. Workers have limited information about the payoffs of applying to different firms. Firms use wages to attract workers and mediate externalities among applicants. Limited information interacts with the allocative role of wages, leading to new predictions. Reducing information friction has non-monotonic impacts on efficiency. When the cost of acquiring information is low (high), alleviating the information friction reduces (exacerbates) the distortion in the market equilibrium. I then apply this model to discuss the implications of improvements in information technology and the spillover effects among workers in the labor market.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个具有灵活信息可得性程度的均衡搜索模型对劳动力市场的影响，该模型将随机搜索和定向搜索模型作为特例。工人对申请不同企业的收益信息有限。企业使用工资来吸引工人并调节申请者之间的外部性。有限信息与工资的配置作用相互作用，产生了新的预测。减少信息摩擦对效率的影响是非单调的。当获取信息的成本低（高）时，缓解信息摩擦会减少（加剧）市场均衡中的扭曲。然后，我将此模型应用于讨论信息技术改进的影响以及工人之间在劳动力市场中的溢出效应。

articles.title_en: The equilibrium-value convergence for the multiple-partners game
articles.title_cn: 多伙伴博弈的均衡值收敛性
articles.abstract_en: We study the assignment game (Shapley and Shubik, 1972) and its generalization of the multiple-partners game (Sotomayor, 1992), the simplest many-to-many extension. Our main result is that the Shapley value of a replicated multiple-partners game converges to a competitive equilibrium payoff when the number of replicas tends to infinity. The result also holds for a large subclass of semivalues since we prove that they converge to the same value as the replica becomes large. Furthermore, in supermodular and monotonic assignment games, the asymptotic Shapley value coincides with the mean stable imputation. The proof of our theorem relies on Hall's theorem.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究指派博弈（Shapley和Shubik，1972）及其推广的多伙伴博弈（Sotomayor，1992），这是最简单的多对多扩展。我们的主要结果是，当复制数量趋于无穷时，复制多伙伴博弈的Shapley值收敛于竞争均衡收益。该结果也适用于一大类半值，因为我们证明了当复制规模变大时，它们收敛到相同的值。此外，在超模和单调指派博弈中，渐近Shapley值与平均稳定分配一致。我们定理的证明依赖于Hall定理。

articles.title_en: Cognitive hierarchies for games in extensive form
articles.title_cn: 扩展式博弈中的认知层级
articles.abstract_en: In the cognitive hierarchy (CH) framework, players in a game have heterogeneous levels of strategic sophistication. Each player believes that other players in the game are less sophisticated, and these beliefs correspond to the truncated distribution of a “true” distribution of levels. We develop the dynamic cognitive hierarchy (DCH) solution by extending the CH framework to games in extensive form. Initial beliefs are updated as the history of play provides information about players' levels of sophistication. We establish some general properties of DCH and fully characterize the DCH solution for a wide class of centipede games. DCH predicts a strategy-reduction effect: there will be earlier taking if the centipede game is played as an alternating-move sequential game rather than as a simultaneous move game in its reduced normal form. Experimental evidence reported in García-Pola et al. (2020a) supports this prediction. In all three centipede games for which the DCH strategy-reduction effect is predicted, termination occurs earlier when played sequentially rather than simultaneously with reduced strategies. In a fourth centipede game, where this effect is not predicted, it is not observed.
articles.abstract_cn: 在认知层级（CH）框架中，博弈中的参与者具有不同水平的战略 sophistication。每个参与者都认为博弈中的其他参与者不那么 sophisticated，并且这些信念对应于“真实”层级分布的截断分布。我们通过将 CH 框架扩展到扩展式博弈，发展了动态认知层级（DCH）解。随着博弈历史提供关于参与者 sophistication 水平的信息，初始信念会被更新。我们建立了 DCH 的一些一般性质，并完整刻画了一类广泛的蜈蚣博弈的 DCH 解。DCH 预测了一种策略缩减效应：如果蜈蚣博弈以交替行动的序贯博弈形式进行，而不是以其缩减正规形式的同步行动博弈进行，那么会更早地终止。García-Pola 等人（2020a）报告的实验证据支持这一预测。在所有三个预测 DCH 策略缩减效应的蜈蚣博弈中，当以序贯方式而非同步方式使用缩减策略进行时，终止发生得更早。在第四个蜈蚣博弈中，未预测到这种效应，也未观察到该效应。

articles.title_en: Influencer marketing and product competition
articles.title_cn: 网红营销与产品竞争
articles.abstract_en: With the rise of social platforms and digital media (e.g., videos, (live)streaming, and multi-media blogs), firms and brand owners increasingly depend on influencers to attract consumers, who care about both product quality and consumer-influencer interaction. Sellers thus compete in both influencer and product markets. We develop a theory to understand the influencer labor market and its interaction with product competition, under a plausible specification of influencers' value added. We find: (i) more powerful influencers sell better quality products for sellers with weaker direct-sale capacity, facilitating seller competition; (ii) advances in the intermediation technology can lead to non-monotonic changes in influencers' payoff and income inequality; (iii) style pluralism mitigates market concentration by horizontally differentiating the consumer experience but serves as either complements (intermediate style dispersion) or substitutes (small or large dispersions) to vertical product differentiation; and (iv) influencers may inefficiently under-invest in consumer outreach and unidirectional exclusivity can improve welfare in less competitive markets. Collectively, our findings highlight the novelty of the influencer economy and establish several theoretical baselines for future studies.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着社交平台和数字媒体（如视频、（直播）流媒体和多媒体博客）的兴起，企业和品牌所有者越来越依赖网红来吸引消费者，这些消费者既关心产品质量，也关心消费者与网红之间的互动。因此，卖家在网红市场和产品市场中都进行竞争。我们发展了一个理论来理解网红劳动力市场及其与产品竞争的相互作用，在网红增值的合理设定下。我们发现：（i）更有影响力的网红为直接销售能力较弱的卖家销售更高质量的产品，促进了卖家竞争；（ii）中介技术的进步可能导致网红报酬和收入不平等的非单调变化；（iii）风格多元化通过横向差异化消费者体验来缓解市场集中，但作为垂直产品差异化的互补品（中等风格分散度）或替代品（小或大的分散度）；（iv）网红可能低效地投资不足于消费者拓展，单向排他性可以在竞争较少的市场中提高福利。总的来说，我们的发现突出了网红经济的新颖性，并为未来研究建立了几个理论基线。

articles.title_en: Sequential trading with coarse contingencies
articles.title_cn: 粗粒度偶然事件下的序贯交易
articles.abstract_en: We consider a dynamic pure exchange economy in which agents have a coarse perception of the future, and awareness emerges gradually over time. We make the key assumption that awareness of a shock to agents' endowments emerges before the shock hits, so agents can adapt by purchasing (or selling) insurance. We provide an irrelevance theorem showing that, under suitable conditions, unawareness matters if and only if it concerns aggregate shocks. In particular, if the unforeseen endowment shocks are purely idiosyncratic, there is no loss of efficiency with respect to the economy with perfect foresight. Building on this result, we show three key implications of unforeseen aggregate shocks: the possibility of non-comonotonic consumption allocations, a systematic bias in asset prices that gives rise to opportunities for intertemporal arbitrage, and the potential of unexpected default due to the agents' inability to repay (roll over) prior debt.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个动态纯交换经济，其中代理人对未来具有粗粒度的感知，而意识随时间逐渐显现。我们做出关键假设，即对代理人禀赋冲击的意识在冲击发生之前就已显现，因此代理人可以通过购买（或出售）保险来适应。我们提供了一个无关性定理，表明在适当条件下，无意识仅在涉及总体冲击时才重要。特别是，如果未预见的禀赋冲击纯粹是异质性的，则相对于具有完美预见的经济，不存在效率损失。基于这一结果，我们展示了未预见总体冲击的三个关键含义：非共同单调消费分配的可能性、资产价格中的系统性偏差（这为跨期套利提供了机会），以及由于代理人无法偿还（展期）先前债务而导致的意外违约可能性。

articles.title_en: The perils of fiscal feedback rules
articles.title_cn: 财政反馈规则的危险
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a fiscal feedback rule (FFR) in an endogenous growth model with public debt dynamics. We assume that part of the debt burden is covered by tax increases (we name this “sterilization”), while the remaining part is financed by issuing new debt. We show that while low sterilization does not ensure the existence of a long-run steady state, high sterilization can lead to multiple steady states and aggregate instability in the form of local and global indeterminacy, potentially condemning the economy to a low-growth/high-debt trap steady state and long-lasting public debt cycles. By combining econometric estimations and a calibration exercise on developed economies, we highlight that these various perils can occur for empirically plausible values of the sterilization coefficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在具有公共债务动态的内生增长模型中引入了财政反馈规则（FFR）。我们假设债务负担的一部分通过增税来覆盖（我们称之为“ sterilization”），而剩余部分则通过发行新债来融资。我们表明，虽然低 sterilization 不能确保长期稳态的存在，但高 sterilization 可能导致多重稳态和总体不稳定，表现为局部和全局不确定性，可能使经济陷入低增长/高债务陷阱的稳态和长期公共债务周期。通过结合发达经济体的计量经济学估计和校准练习，我们强调这些各种危险可能在 sterilization 系数的经验合理值下发生。

articles.title_en: Fomenting conflict
articles.title_cn: 煽动冲突
articles.abstract_en: I study information disclosure as a means to create conflict. A sender aims to keep two parties engaged in a war of attrition and reveals information about their relative strength. In the unique Markov Perfect Equilibrium, the sender employs “shifting rhetoric”: she alternates pipetting good and bad news about each party, so that neither appears too strong. Information designed to induce one party to continue fighting weakens the other party's incentives. This spillover effect may lead to early resolution and leave the sender worse off. With commitment, the sender provides delayed noisy disclosures. A partisan sender, who favors one party, instead provides information which leads to immediate resolution.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究信息披露作为制造冲突的一种手段。一个发送者旨在让两方陷入消耗战，并揭示关于他们相对实力的信息。在唯一的马尔可夫完美均衡中，发送者采用“转变性言论”：她交替向每一方传递好坏消息，使得任何一方都不会显得过于强大。旨在诱导一方继续战斗的信息会削弱另一方的激励。这种溢出效应可能导致早期解决，并使发送者处境更糟。在有承诺的情况下，发送者提供延迟的嘈杂披露。一个偏袒一方的党派性发送者，则提供导致立即解决的信息。

articles.title_en: The Ramsey steady-state conundrum in heterogeneous-agent economies
articles.title_cn: 异质性主体经济中的拉姆齐稳态难题
articles.abstract_en: This paper makes two fundamental contributions: (i) We prove that the interior Ramsey steady state commonly assumed in the literature may not exist in a standard Aiyagari model—in particular, a steady state with the modified golden rule and a positive capital tax is shown to be feasible but not optimal under conventional parameter values for the intertemporal elasticity of substitution. (ii) We design a modified, analytically tractable version of the standard Aiyagari model to reveal the necessary and/or sufficient conditions for the existence of a Ramsey steady state. We characterize the basic properties of both interior and non-interior Ramsey steady states and show that researchers may draw fundamentally misleading conclusions about optimal fiscal policy (such as the optimal capital tax rate) from their analysis if an interior Ramsey steady state is incorrectly assumed.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文做出两项基础性贡献：（i）我们证明，在标准的艾亚加里模型中，文献中通常假设的内部拉姆齐稳态可能不存在——特别是，在跨期替代弹性的常规参数值下，满足修正黄金法则且资本税为正的稳态被证明是可行的，但并非最优的。（ii）我们设计了一个标准艾亚加里模型的修正且解析可处理的版本，以揭示拉姆齐稳态存在的必要和/或充分条件。我们刻画了内部和非内部拉姆齐稳态的基本性质，并表明如果错误地假设存在内部拉姆齐稳态，研究人员可能会从他们的分析中得出关于最优财政政策（如最优资本税率）的根本性误导结论。

articles.title_en: Statistical uncertainty and coarse contracts
articles.title_cn: 统计不确定性与粗糙契约
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a robust contracting problem with a standard principal and a strictly risk-averse agent who is (i) uncertain about the production technology and (ii) ambiguity-averse in the sense of the Bewley (1986) incomplete preferences criterion. When the agent's uncertainty is sufficiently limited, the optimal contract is fully contingent on the state of the world, as in the classical problem. Conversely, when that uncertainty is sufficiently extensive, the optimal contract is (generically) a binary contract with only two distinct payment levels. In intermediate cases, the optimal contract becomes progressively more detailed as the agent becomes increasingly certain about the technology. We provide a statistical interpretation of our model under which the principal's beliefs and the agent's belief sets are as if they were derived from the public observation of i.i.d. output data.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个稳健缔约问题，其中包含一个标准委托人和一个严格风险厌恶的代理人，该代理人（i）对生产技术存在不确定性，并且（ii）在Bewley（1986）不完全偏好准则意义下是模糊厌恶的。当代理人的不确定性足够有限时，最优契约完全依赖于世界状态，如同经典问题中的情形。相反，当该不确定性足够广泛时，最优契约（一般地）是一个二元契约，仅有两个不同的支付水平。在中间情形下，随着代理人对技术越来越确定，最优契约逐渐变得更加详细。我们为我们的模型提供了一种统计解释，在该解释下，委托人的信念和代理人的信念集如同是从公开观察到的独立同分布产出数据中推导出来的。

articles.title_en: Disaster learning and aggregate investment
articles.title_cn: 灾难学习与总体投资
articles.abstract_en: We extend a production-based asset pricing model by introducing learning about disaster risk. The information is not perfect, and Bayesian learning is adopted to update beliefs about the likelihood of rare disasters. We show that disaster learning reconciles key stylized facts about macroeconomic quantities and financial markets. For macroeconomic quantities, during the crisis, the decline in aggregate investments is much worse than that of output, whereas the decline in aggregate consumption is moderate relative to that of output. Additionally, the model endogenously features lower consumption volatility and higher investment volatility than that of output. For financial markets, belief updating over a rare disaster produces a higher equity premium, lower risk-free rate, and more volatile stock returns. Finally, we show that jump intensity uncertainty accounts for a substantial fraction of the total welfare cost of rare disasters.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过引入关于灾难风险的学习来扩展一个基于生产的资产定价模型。信息并非完美，采用贝叶斯学习来更新对罕见灾难可能性的信念。我们表明，灾难学习调和了关于宏观经济总量和金融市场的关键典型事实。对于宏观经济总量，在危机期间，总体投资的下降比产出严重得多，而总体消费的下降相对于产出则较为温和。此外，该模型内生地呈现出比产出更低的消费波动性和更高的投资波动性。对于金融市场，对罕见灾难的信念更新产生了更高的股权溢价、更低的无风险利率和更波动的股票收益。最后，我们表明跳跃强度不确定性占罕见灾难总福利成本的相当大一部分。

articles.title_en: Optimal influence design in networks
articles.title_cn: 网络中的最优影响设计
articles.abstract_en: We examine an influence designer's optimal intervention in the presence of social learning in a network. Before learning begins, the designer alters initial opinions of agents within the network to shift their ultimate opinions to be as close as possible to the target opinions. By decomposing the influence matrix, which summarizes the learning structure, we transform the designer's problem into one with an orthogonal basis. This transformation allows us to characterize optimal interventions under complete information. We also demonstrate that even in cases where the designer has incomplete information about the network structure, the designer can still design an asymptotically optimal intervention in a large network. Finally, we provide examples and extensions, including repeated social learning and competition.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在存在社会学习的网络中，影响设计者的最优干预。在学习开始之前，设计者会改变网络中代理的初始意见，以使其最终意见尽可能接近目标意见。通过分解概括学习结构的影响矩阵，我们将设计者的问题转化为具有正交基的问题。这种转化使我们能够在完全信息下刻画最优干预。我们还证明，即使设计者对网络结构的信息不完全，在大规模网络中，设计者仍然可以设计出渐近最优的干预。最后，我们提供了例子和扩展，包括重复社会学习和竞争。

articles.title_en: Implementing randomized allocation rules with outcome-contingent transfers
articles.title_cn: 实施带有结果依赖转移的随机分配规则
articles.abstract_en: We study a mechanism design problem where the allocation rule is randomized and transfers are contingent on outcomes. In this problem, an agent reports his private information, and an exogenous randomized allocation rule assigns an outcome based on the report. A planner designs an outcome-contingent transfer to incentivize the agent to report truthfully. We say that the allocation rule is implementable if such transfers exist. For this implementation problem, we derive two sufficient and necessary conditions. Each has a geometric interpretation. Moreover, when the allocation rule is implementable, we construct transfers that implement the allocation rule.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个机制设计问题，其中分配规则是随机的，转移依赖于结果。在这个问题中，一个代理人报告其私人信息，一个外生的随机分配规则根据报告分配一个结果。规划者设计一个结果依赖的转移以激励代理人如实报告。如果这样的转移存在，我们说分配规则是可实施的。对于这个实施问题，我们推导出两个充分必要条件。每个条件都有几何解释。此外，当分配规则可实施时，我们构造了实施该分配规则的转移。

articles.title_en: Branching-independent random utility model
articles.title_cn: 分支独立随机效用模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a subclass of the Random Utility Model (RUM), called branching-independent RUM. In this subclass, the probability distribution over the ordinal rankings of alternatives satisfies the following property: for any k ∈ { 1 , … , n − 1 } , where n denotes the number of alternatives, when fixing the first k and the last n − k alternatives, the relative rankings of the first k and the last n − k alternatives are independent. Branching-independence is motivated by the classical example due to Fishburn (1998), which illustrates the non-uniqueness problem in random utility models. Surprisingly, branching-independent RUM is characterized by the Block-Marschak condition, which also characterizes general RUM. In fact, I show that a construction similar to the one used in Falmagne (1978) generates a branching-independent RUM. In addition, within the class of branching-independent RUMs, the probability distribution over preferences is uniquely determined. Hence, while branching-independent RUM has the same explanatory power as general RUM, it is uniquely identified.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文引入了随机效用模型（RUM）的一个子类，称为分支独立RUM。在该子类中，关于备选方案序数排序的概率分布满足以下性质：对于任意 k ∈ { 1 , … , n − 1 }，其中 n 表示备选方案的数量，当固定前 k 个和最后 n − k 个备选方案时，前 k 个与最后 n − k 个备选方案的相对排序是独立的。分支独立性源于 Fishburn (1998) 的经典例子，该例子说明了随机效用模型中的非唯一性问题。令人惊讶的是，分支独立RUM由 Block-Marschak 条件刻画，该条件也刻画了一般RUM。事实上，我证明了类似于 Falmagne (1978) 中使用的构造可以生成分支独立RUM。此外，在分支独立RUM类中，偏好上的概率分布是唯一确定的。因此，虽然分支独立RUM与一般RUM具有相同的解释力，但它是唯一识别的。

articles.title_en: Sorting versus screening in decentralized markets with adverse selection
articles.title_cn: 逆向选择下分散市场中的分类与筛选
articles.abstract_en: We study the role of traders' meeting capacities in decentralized markets with adverse selection. Uninformed principals choose trading mechanisms to find an agent with whom to trade. Agents are privately informed about their quality and aim to match with one of the principals. We consider a rich set of meeting technologies and characterize the properties of the equilibrium allocations for each of them. In equilibrium, different agent types can be separated either via sorting—they self-select into different submarkets—or screening within the trading mechanism, or a combination of the two. We show that, as the meeting capacity increases, the equilibrium features more screening and less sorting. Interestingly, this increases price variability and reduces the average quality of trade as well as the total level of trade in the economy. The trading losses are, however, more than compensated by savings in entry costs so that welfare increases.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了交易者会面能力在具有逆向选择的分散市场中的作用。不知情的委托人选择交易机制以寻找与之交易的代理人。代理人私下了解自己的质量，并旨在与其中一位委托人匹配。我们考虑了一系列丰富的会面技术，并刻画了每种技术下均衡配置的性质。在均衡中，不同类型的代理人可以通过分类——他们自我选择进入不同的子市场——或通过交易机制内的筛选，或两者的结合来分离。我们表明，随着会面能力的增加，均衡中筛选更多而分类更少。有趣的是，这增加了价格波动性，并降低了平均交易质量以及经济中的总交易水平。然而，交易损失被进入成本的节省所更多补偿，因此福利增加。

articles.title_en: Preference manipulations lead to the uniform rule
articles.title_cn: 偏好操纵导致统一规则
articles.abstract_en: For the problem of fully allocating a social endowment of a commodity among a group of agents with single-peaked preferences, we study the consequences of manipulation for several families of rules that are not strategy-proof. Given a rule and a true preference profile, we consider the induced direct revelation game, and characterize its equilibrium allocations in terms of the profile. Our results are unequivocal: for any rule we consider, and for each true preference profile, there is a unique Nash equilibrium allocation. For the profile, it is the allocation of the uniform rule (Sprumont, 1991), the unique strategy-proof, efficient, and symmetric rule in this literature. These conclusions are drawn from two distinct sets of assumptions on the rules.
articles.abstract_cn: 针对在具有单峰偏好的代理人群体中完全分配一种商品的社会禀赋的问题，我们研究了操纵对几类非策略证明规则的影响。给定一个规则和一个真实偏好分布，我们考虑由此引发的直接揭示博弈，并根据该分布刻画其均衡配置。我们的结果是明确的：对于我们所考虑的任何规则，以及每个真实偏好分布，都存在唯一的纳什均衡配置。对于该分布，它是统一规则（Sprumont, 1991）的配置，即该文献中唯一的策略证明、有效且对称的规则。这些结论基于对规则的两组不同假设得出。

articles.title_en: Do taxspots matter?: A study of optimal tax uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 税收斑点重要吗？：最优税收不确定性研究
articles.abstract_en: Should the government run an uncertain fiscal policy to finance its liabilities? We call the resulting uncertainty taxspots, and study conditions that make taxspots optimal and recurrent in standard Ramsey problems. We show that prudence and market incompleteness play a role in sustaining taxspots, and that equal-treatment randomizations can be decentralized via taxspots even in the absence of financial markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 政府是否应该实施不确定的财政政策来为其负债融资？我们将由此产生的不确定性称为税收斑点，并研究在标准拉姆齐问题中使税收斑点最优且反复出现的条件。我们表明，谨慎性和市场不完全性在维持税收斑点方面发挥作用，并且即使在缺乏金融市场的情况下，平等对待的随机化也可以通过税收斑点进行分散化。

articles.title_en: Consumer heterogeneity and inefficiency in oligopoly markets
articles.title_cn: 寡头市场中的消费者异质性与无效率
articles.abstract_en: Motivated by several recent studies on oligopolistic markets with consumer heterogeneity, we characterize the geometric properties of a class of inequalities involving the product of two integrals of the probability density quantile function and its reciprocal. Through three applications, we illustrate how our characterization can help enrich our understanding of the existing findings and shed some new insights, regarding the extent to which consumer welfare and social efficiency depend on the properties of the distributions of consumer valuation heterogeneity.
articles.abstract_cn: 受近期几项关于具有消费者异质性的寡头市场研究的启发，我们刻画了一类涉及概率密度分位数函数及其倒数两个积分乘积的不等式的几何性质。通过三个应用，我们展示了我们的刻画如何有助于加深对现有发现的理解，并针对消费者福利和社会效率在多大程度上取决于消费者估值异质性分布的性质提供一些新的见解。

articles.title_en: The central bank, the treasury, or the market: Which one determines the price level?
articles.title_cn: 中央银行、财政部还是市场：哪一个决定价格水平？
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a model in which the price level is the outcome of dynamic strategic interactions between fiscal and monetary authorities that pursue distinct objectives. The “unpleasant monetarist arithmetic”, whereby aggressive fiscal expansion forces the monetary authority to chicken out and to lose control of inflation, occurs only if the public sector lacks fiscal space, in the sense that public debt along the optimal fiscal path gets sufficiently close to the threshold above which the fiscal authority would find default optimal. Otherwise, monetary dominance prevails even though the central bank has neither commitment power nor fiscal backing.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个模型，在该模型中，价格水平是追求不同目标的财政当局与货币当局之间动态战略互动的结果。只有当公共部门缺乏财政空间，即沿着最优财政路径的公共债务足够接近财政当局认为违约最优的阈值时，才会出现“不愉快的货币主义算术”，即激进的财政扩张迫使货币当局退缩并失去对通胀的控制。否则，即使中央银行既没有承诺能力也没有财政支持，货币主导权仍将 prevails。
